messages.content:
You are an expert programmer working in a language based on lambda calculus.
Your goal is to write programs that accomplish the tasks specified by the user.
This is a domain-specific language for regular expressions that specify string transformations.

Write programs using the available functions:

'.' :: tsubstr

empty_string :: tsubstr

'a' :: tsubstr

'b' :: tsubstr

'c' :: tsubstr

'd' :: tsubstr

'e' :: tsubstr

'f' :: tsubstr

'g' :: tsubstr

'h' :: tsubstr

'i' :: tsubstr

'j' :: tsubstr

'k' :: tsubstr

'l' :: tsubstr

'm' :: tsubstr

'n' :: tsubstr

'o' :: tsubstr

'p' :: tsubstr

'q' :: tsubstr

'r' :: tsubstr

's' :: tsubstr

't' :: tsubstr

'u' :: tsubstr

'v' :: tsubstr

'w' :: tsubstr

'x' :: tsubstr

'y' :: tsubstr

'z' :: tsubstr

regex_not :: tsubstr -> tsubstr

regex_or :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr

regex_concat :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr

regex_match :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> bool

regex_split :: tsubstr -> tfullstr -> list(tsubstr)

regex_flatten :: list(tsubstr) -> tfullstr

regex_tail :: list(tsubstr) -> tsubstr

regex_append :: t0 -> list(t0) -> list(t0)

regex_reverse_cdr :: list(t0) -> list(t0)

regex_if :: bool -> t0 -> t0 -> t0

regex_cons :: t0 -> list(t0) -> list(t0)

regex_car :: list(t0) -> t0

regex_cdr :: list(t0) -> list(t0)

regex_map :: (t0 -> t1) -> list(t0) -> list(t1)

replace_if_match :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map (lambda (regex_if (regex_match $1 $0) $2 $0)) (regex_split '.' $2))))))
description: Applies a replacement if a substring matches a given pattern in a full string. The function takes a full string, a pattern to match, and a replacement substring. It checks for the pattern in the full string and replaces it with the specified substring if found.

replace_start_with_substring :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_cons $0 (regex_cdr (regex_split '.' $1))))))
description: Replaces the starting character or characters of a word in a full string with a specified substring.

replace_substrings_in_full_string :: tfullstr -> (tsubstr -> tsubstr) -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map $0 (regex_split '.' $1)))))
description: Applies a transformation function to each substring of a full string separated by a delimiter.

replace_end_with_substring :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append $0 (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_split '.' $1))))))
description: Replaces the ending character or characters of a word in a full string with a specified substring.

replace_if_match_and_concat_a :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (replace_if_match $0 (regex_concat 'a' $1) $2))))
description: Applies a replacement if a substring matches a given pattern in a full string, and concatenates 'a' with the replacement substring.

replace_if_match_and_concat_u :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (replace_if_match $0 (regex_concat 'u' $1) $2))))
description: Applies a replacement if a substring matches a given pattern in a full string, and concatenates 'u' with the replacement substring.

replace_if_match_and_concat_t :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (replace_if_match $0 (regex_concat $1 't') $2))))
description: Applies a replacement if a substring matches a given pattern in a full string, and concatenates 't' with the replacement substring.

split_string_into_list :: tfullstr -> list(tsubstr)
(lambda (regex_split empty_string $0))
description: Splits a full string into a list of substrings based on an empty string delimiter.

replace_substrings_with_concatenation :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (replace_substrings_in_full_string $0 (lambda (regex_concat $2 $3))))))
description: Replaces substrings in a full string with a concatenation of two specified substrings.

append_and_flatten :: list(tsubstr) -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append $0 $1))))
description: Appends a specified substring to each element in a list of substrings and flattens the result into a full string.
Here are some example programs:
-- if the word starts with any letter replace that with w i
(lambda (replace_start_with_substring $0 (regex_concat 'w' 'i')))
-- if the word ends with any letter any letter replace that with b j
(lambda (append_and_flatten (regex_append 'b' (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_reverse_cdr (split_string_into_list $0)))) 'j'))
-- if there is any letter replace that with w t
(lambda (replace_substrings_with_concatenation 't' 'w' $0))
-- if there is any letter replace that with r v
(lambda (replace_substrings_with_concatenation 'v' 'r' $0))
-- if there is d replace that with c t
(lambda (replace_if_match_and_concat_t 'd' 'c' $0))
-- if there is i replace that with k t
(lambda (replace_if_match_and_concat_t 'i' 'k' $0))
-- if there is g replace that with u f
(lambda (replace_if_match_and_concat_u 'g' 'f' $0))
-- if the word starts with any letter replace that with b
(lambda (replace_start_with_substring $0 'b'))
-- if there is t replace that with a x
(lambda (replace_if_match_and_concat_a 't' 'x' $0))
-- if there is d replace that with a v
(lambda (replace_if_match_and_concat_a 'd' 'v' $0))
-- if the word starts with any letter add v before that
(lambda (append_and_flatten (regex_cons 'v' (split_string_into_list $0)) empty_string))
-- if the word starts with any letter replace that with e s
(lambda (replace_start_with_substring $0 (regex_concat 'e' 's')))
-- if there is any letter add v after that
(lambda (replace_substrings_in_full_string $0 (lambda (regex_concat $0 'v'))))
-- if there is p replace that with g
(lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map (lambda (regex_if (regex_match 'p' $0) 'g' $0)) (split_string_into_list $0))))
-- if the word ends with any letter replace that with f
(lambda (replace_end_with_substring $0 'f'))
-- if there is s replace that with r a
(lambda (replace_if_match $0 (regex_concat 'r' 'a') 's'))
-- if there is t replace that with n
(lambda (replace_if_match $0 'n' 't'))
-- if the word ends with consonant replace that with i
(lambda (replace_end_with_substring $0 'i'))
-- if there is t replace that with i
(lambda (replace_if_match $0 'i' 't'))
-- if there is i replace that with m
(lambda (replace_substrings_in_full_string $0 (lambda (regex_if (regex_match $0 'i') 'm' $0))))
-- if the word ends with any letter add d after that
(lambda (append_and_flatten (split_string_into_list $0) 'd'))
-- if there is a replace that with u c
(lambda (replace_if_match_and_concat_u 'a' 'c' $0))
-- if there is vowel replace that with a c
(lambda (replace_if_match_and_concat_a (regex_or 'a' (regex_or 'e' (regex_or 'o' (regex_or 'i' 'u')))) 'c' $0))
-- if there is l add m before that
